narrative.overview: The design system for the Interactive Maps platform prioritizes precision, clarity, and task efficiency. As an enterprise dispatch tool, it avoids decorative gimmicks like glassmorphism or floating, low-contrast UI cards. The workspace is split between a dominant map viewport and highly dense control sidebars.
keyCharacteristics: High contrast hierarchy for rapid scanning.
Restrained color application, reserving saturation for status, routes, and active user selections.

rules.name: The Saturation Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors (Command Blue, Alert Red) must never cover more than 10% of any control panel surface.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Docked sidebars, panels, and inner layout containers must not use shadows. They utilize solid neutral borders (#e8eaed) for layout division.

dos: Do use high-contrast text ratios exceeding 4.5:1.
Do use strict border lines (#dadce0 or #e8eaed) for sidebar panel layout separation.
Do limit animations to standard transitions under 250ms that directly signal a state change.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism, transparent backdrop-blurs, or saturated color gradients.
Don't use thick colored borders (greater than 1px) on cards or tabs to indicate accent styles.
Don't animate image objects or card layouts on idle hover states.
